exposure: previous one lower segment caesarean section (LSCS)
outcome: successful vaginal birth after Caesarean section (VBAC)
cohort: 258 women with singleton pregnancy, cephalic presentation, previous one LSCS, and without contraindications for vaginal delivery
finding: The Flamm and Geiger score of >5 demonstrated high sensitivity, specificity, PPV, and accuracy in predicting successful VBAC.
